members.description: Adversaries may use utilities to compress and/or encrypt collected data prior to exfiltration.

members.source_section: Requirement V11.1.1 (V11.1 Cryptographic Inventory and Documentation)
members.description: Verify that there is a documented policy for management of cryptographic keys and a cryptographic key lifecycle that follows a key management standard such as NIST SP 800-57.

Verify that the application is designed with crypto agility such that random number, authenticated encryption, MAC, or hashing algorithms, key lengths, rounds, ciphers and modes can be reconfigured, upgraded, or swapped at any time, to protect against cryptographic breaks.
Verify that any combination of an encryption algorithm and a MAC algorithm is operating in encrypt-then-MAC mode.
Strong cryptography and security protocols are implemented to safeguard PAN during transmission over open, public networks.
PAN is secured with strong cryptography whenever it is sent via end-user messaging technologies (for example, email, instant messaging, SMS, chat).
